subject: Stakeholder heatmap + proposed steering committee date
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ariel Gomez <ariel.gomez@finexus.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finexus.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick discovery recap + next steps

Hi Ariel / Marta — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Key goals we heard: (1) reduce inference cost for LLM-based risk scoring, (2) meet 200ms p50 latency for question-answering flows, (3) ensure audit logs/KMS for regulated PII.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency, cost per 1k tokens, and SOC2 evidence.

Action items / asks from your side:
- Can you confirm the economic buyer / exec sponsor for this initiative?
- Please share the primary security contact (infosec) and procurement contact for contracting.

Attached is the security questionnaire you asked for during the call — we completed the fields we can and marked a few items for your infosec to verify. Also starting a living mutual action plan (link below) that we can convert to a shared spreadsheet.

Attachments: [attachment: Finexus_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf]
Link: https://miro.com/app/board/uXjFINEXUS-heatmap/ (stakeholder heatmap draft)

Proposed steering committee / exec sponsor session: we recommend a 45-minute slot (overview + risks + decision checklist). Please propose 2 x 45-minute windows next week — we can run the session remotely and keep the agenda tight: 
1) Intro & objectives (5m)
2) Tech fit & perf profile (10m)
3) Security/compliance Qs (10m)
4) Commercial/Procurement path (10m)
5) Next steps & decision criteria alignment (10m)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with an internal prep note and owners.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Ariel Gomez <ariel.gomez@finexus.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finexus.com>, Procurement <procurement@finexus.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick discovery recap + next steps

Thanks Jasmine — great summary. A couple of quick items from our side: 

- Economic buyer / exec sponsor: Marta Ruiz (CFO) will be the exec sponsor and will join the steering committee.
- Security contact: cc'd procurement for contract funnel and infosec will be in a follow-up (I'll loop Carlos from InfoSec separately).
- Procurement email above is the right channel for commercial terms.

We can do the steering committee on either Oct 7 (10:00–10:45 PT) or Oct 8 (10:00–10:45 PT). Prefer Oct 8 if that works for your team.

Also attaching our standard vendor RFP template — we filled the high level. Happy to review your questionnaire answers once Rishi has had a look.

Best,
Ariel
Head of Data Products, Finexus
ariel.gomez@finexus.com
[attachment: Finexus_RFP_Template.docx]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Quick discovery recap + next steps (internal)

Folks — forwarding Ariel's note. Internal coordination / owners before we lock the steering committee: 

- Rishi: please prioritize the security questionnaire review and flag anything that requires engineering time or a follow-up with the Finexus infosec team. I put the questionnaire in our shared folder and highlighted open items.
- Connor: draft a 2-slide perf/cost summary comparing the hosted vs dedicated options, with latency and per-1k-token economics. Keep it exec-friendly.
- Stephanie: lead on procurement path — outline the expected contracting steps and timing (SOW, PoLP, billing cadence). Draft a suggested commercial playbook for the steering committee.

Decision checklist we need to make before the session: 
1) Who the economic buyer is and what metric will drive the decision (TCO reduction target / latency SLA / both).
2) Any mandatory compliance gating items (e.g., specific cipher suites, retention windows).
3) Commercial cadence: pilot -> committed capacity -> enterprise contract.

Proposed meeting times (per Ariel): Oct 7 10:00 PT or Oct 8 10:00 PT. If we take Oct 8, need to have the draft slides and the MAP (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) ready by Oct 6 EOD so I can circulate.

Attaching a starter MAP (internal draft).
Attachments: [attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx]

Thanks — let's be lean on slides and heavy on decision criteria.

— Jasmine

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ariel Gomez <ariel.gomez@finexus.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finexus.com>, Procurement <procurement@finexus.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Steering committee — proposed confirmed slot & agenda (Oct 8, 10:00 PT)

Hi Ariel / Marta / procurement — per your note and internal alignment, we propose to hold the steering committee on Oct 8, 10:00–10:45 PT. Please confirm availability; if we don't hear back by EOD PDT tomorrow, we'll hold the slot tentative and send a calendar invite.

Draft agenda (45m):
1) Welcome & objective (Jasmine) — 5m
2) Business outcomes & decision criteria (Marta / Finexus) — 10m
3) Technical fit & perf profile (Connor) — 10m
4) Security & compliance Qs (Rishi) — 8m
5) Commercial path & timing (Stephanie) — 7m
6) Wrap & next steps (All) — 5m

Attached: updated security questionnaire (we incorporated a few clarifying notes) and the mutual action plan with owners. Please review the security items that are marked "Finexus input required."

Attachments: [attachment: Finexus_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf], [attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx]
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654321 (deal record)

Calendar placeholder: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finexus-steering-oct8

If possible, please confirm who from legal (if needed) will attend — you previously mentioned looping legal / procurement; if they cannot make the time, we can do a separate 30-minute legal + procurement sync the following week.

Looking forward — we will prepare a one-pager for Marta summarizing options and recommended decision path.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
